messages:
jordan m: Need a compact SI co-sell handoff for leads from cloud marketplaces and HW partners. We're getting delays and messy crediting. Proposal: a 5-step flow + announcement annex. Thoughts?

tess y: Agree. 5-step sounds right. Intake -> pre-qual -> AE assign -> SI engagement window -> resolution (engaged or timed_out). Keep fields minimal in SFDC.

omar h: Suggested SFDC fields: Lead.Source, Lead.Partner_ID, Lead.Handshake_State (pending|engaged|timed_out), Lead.SI_Contact, Exclusivity_Window_days, Deal_Registration_ID, Announcement_Flag.

jordan m: Default windows: 48h ack from SI, 7 business days to confirm engagement unless Deal_Registration extends it. If timed_out, AE reclaims.

elaine r: Announcement annex: if Announcement_Flag = yes, require PMM + Legal + SI asset check. Lead time: 4 weeks for blog-only, 8 weeks for press. Add Announcement_Legal_Cleared boolean.

revops: For crediting we need Partner_Credit_Type (referral|co-sell|reseller) and a rule: duplicates within 30 days get credit evaluated at close. We'll own mapping.

omar h: Automation: when Handshake_State=engaged partners-bot posts summary to #go-to-market and creates task for AE with two templates (joint intro + SI no-show). Use partner_handshake:pending|engaged|timed_out labels for analytics.

tess y: For HW partners add an Inventory_Check flag and pause announcement if inventory insufficient. Also require Deal_Registration_ID for partner-protected deals.

jordan m: Action items: Omar to PR SFDC field spec (EOD Wed), Elaine drafts announcement checklist (Tue), Tess drafts templates + HW step (Fri), Revops to propose credit mapping (next Wed). Partners-bot: please create a checklist page and post templates.

partners-bot: Created Confluence checklist and posted two email templates. :white_check_mark:

jordan m: We'll pilot this on the next 4 marketplace/hw referrals and adjust. If anyone sees edge cases, drop them here.

elaine r: One edge case to flag: customer-named press quotes need signed release before posting. Adding that to the checklist now.

omar h: Noted. I'll include Deal_Registration_ID and Announcement_Legal_Cleared in the SFDC spec.

revops: I'll sync with finance on credit tagging and post mapping in this thread before next Wed.
